Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD move; arrow keys fire/aim and set facing (movement+firing combine in one action); Space = active item; Q = held card/consumable; waiting delays. Movement ~400px/s, full step ~110px, diagonal ~55px; 0.1-0.15s presses give fine alignment. Doors/hatches require near-exact centering and repeated presses; clear alignment before pushing.

HUD/MECHANICS (observed): hearts (hollow when lost; red hearts plus occasional blue-outlined extra), coins, keys, bombs, card slot. Minimap top-right. Pickups on touch: floor coins, keys, hover fuse-lit pickup (prior run: +1 bomb; this run it raised keys 01→02 — effect uncertain/maybe random), red pill = heal (+blue heart), blue pill = +1 key. Locked gray chests: pressing into them repeatedly with a key held (earlier appeared to open, key not visibly consumed; this run inaccessible because TNT barrels blocked approach — bombs likely needed). Plain poop gives nothing; gilded mound shatters to coins.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear travels ~120px ahead then bursts with ~1.5-tile wide arc; red X marks impact. Blind spot: targets under ~70px are missed — burst detonates past them; in some frames splashes appeared at the far wall, so burst may occur on wall/obstacle impact instead of fixed range (uncertain). Align burst line with enemy row; vertical offset >~70px misses. Damages fat enemies, gilded mounds, wall statue (cracks); does NOT damage TNT barrels (bombs chain-detonate them). Match Stick in Space showed no effect (likely passive). Q with 'II – The High Priestess — Mother is watching you' produced no visible effect (card slot may have changed); card purpose unknown.

PLAYER SPRITE: alternates wildly (white round face, black-eyed face, TV/monitor head, striped egg, yellow blob, bald, invisible frames). Confirm identity by moving. TV-head/gray-faced sprites also appear as ENEMIES — don't assume a sprite is you.

ENEMIES (observed): winged flies; knife-topped; fat pink/white-faced (tanky, enrage with dark mouth, chase, drop black teardrops, point-blank contact drains hearts fast; damaged states show red flash/silhouette; die to sustained ring bursts from ~120-150px); shelled white-faced from rock piles leaving damaging green cloud; blue-white creatures in rocks (disguised enemies); gray wall-faces that spread gray mass, drop teardrops, relocate between wall positions and rock-ring pods, and appear to spawn reinforcements (possibly infinite respawns in the rock room); red flesh/blood entity near top door; blue orbs (suspected enemy projectiles from gray faces, damage unconfirmed); pink stationary orb-emitter survived hits (suspect invulnerable spawner); blue spiral spinner stuck in rocks resisted hits (decor suspected). Green spiky clouds persist seconds and damage on touch. All-hollow hearts while still alive observed once; contact damage seemed not to reduce further (uncertain; possible revive/extra-life state).

FAILED STRATEGIES: walking into brazier rock ring; attacking TNT barrels with tears/rings; firing from <60-70px (blind spot); fighting enraged fat enemies point-blank; lingering in green clouds/teardrop lanes; Q card with no visible effect; Space with Match Stick; pressing inert top-wall marks/wall-crack mark; ignoring static props that may be disguised enemies; trying locked chests while barrels block the path.

NAVIGATION (observed chain): Tutorial room (inert wall diagrams; top door and bottom door) ↔ bottom → brazier room (four lit corner braziers, locked chest sealed inside rock ring, shootable poop, golden gate bottom-center, top alcove back to tutorial) ↔ gate → item room (TECH X pedestal, top gold door back). Tutorial top → rock room (scattered rocks/mounds, left gold keyhole door → SHOP, top and bottom doors; enemy waves incl. shelled, flies, knife, orbs, gray pod faces, spinner). Keyhole door opened with key after ~y=355 alignment and killing gray-face waves (this run it stayed shut while enemies alive — supports clear-gating; key not visibly consumed). SHOP: pedestals 15¢ card, 5¢ bomb; right gold door returns to rock room. Rock room top → TNT room (left barrel column guarding two locked chests, center barrels, crates, top hatch, bottom door back) → top hatch → boss room (fat/knife enemies, gray spawner faces, left-wall statue with red eyes/gold item/blood mist showing ring cracks, gilded mound and sprouts in right rocks, blue spiral + sack in rocks, decorative top-wall marks that are NOT doors, bottom hatch back to TNT room). Prior run also had a giant high-heel-shoe leg boss in that room; exits stayed locked during fights.

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES: doors unlock only on full clear (supported repeatedly); is the wall statue invincible decor or a boss (it is damageable — cracks); does the boss-room hatch require the boss/minions dead; are blue spiral/blue-white rock creatures/red flesh enemies; where is the golden key (keys only from pills/floor pickups so far); what does the card do; meaning of all-hollow hearts; do blue orbs deal damage; does the gray wall-face respawn endlessly in the rock room; whether fuse pickup gives bomb or key; whether locked chests require bombs to reach rather than keys.
